basis.governing_question: How should Seguros Atlântida redesign the operating model of all five business units and plan the transition to it?

sub_questions.question: How do the five units work today, and where do structure, roles and processes fall short?
Which cost, performance and workload gaps in each unit does the target model have to close?
Which target operating model options fit the five units, and which one should the executive committee approve?
How does the chosen model work in detail inside each unit, agreed with each unit's leaders?
What transition plan, by unit, moves each unit from today's way of working to the target model?

drivers.evidence: all five business units (claims, underwriting, sales, customer service and finance)

work.unit: Unit diagnosed (interviews, process walk-throughs, workload and cost baseline)

phase_work.why: Five units diagnosed two at a time, so three rounds; the estimate exceeds the typical 4-8 weeks because the brief covers all five units.

work.unit: Target model for the whole organization (structure, roles, governance)
Unit-level design detailed with the unit's leaders

phase_work.why: Company-wide model first, five unit designs two at a time, then transition plan and review; above typical 6-10 weeks as all five units are designed.

sizing.levers: Running three units at once instead of two in Diagnostic and Design, or a narrower scope than all five units, would shorten the engagement most.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish how each of the five business units works today and where its structure, roles and processes fall short.

gate.label: Diagnostic readout
gate.decision: Which prioritized improvement areas does the design phase take forward?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the target operating model and a transition plan by unit for approval by the executive committee.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the target model and unit transition plans for executive committee approval?

architect_notes: Length is estimated at 22 to 26 weeks, the middle of an 18 to 28 week range; slower unit cycles push it to the top.
No Implementation phase: the type is assessment and the brief asks for a transition plan, not its execution; confirm that the type holds.
No Handover phase: the executive committee is a steering group, so the final gate covers it; confirm if unit heads take over their transition plans.
